class FileAnalyzer(BaseFileAnalyzer):
    def __init__(self, filepath: str):
        super().__init__()
        self._filepath = filepath

    @property
    def filepath(self) -> Path:
        return Path(self._filepath)

    def analyze(self) -> Dict[str, List[str]]:
        function_list = []
        class_list = []
        for function_name, function_body in AstUtils.get_functions(self._filepath):
            function_list.append((function_name, function_body))

        for class_name, class_body in AstUtils.get_classes(self._filepath):
            class_list.append((class_name, class_body))

        return {'functions': function_list, 'classes': class_list}

def _extract_class_method_name(ast_node):
    """Extracts method name from an AST node of a class method"""
    func_body = ast_node.body[0].value
    return func_body.name


def _extract_function_name(ast_node):
    """Extracts function name from an AST node of a function"""
    return ast_node.name


def _extract_class_name(ast_node):
    """Extracts class name from an AST node of a class"""
    return ast_node.name


def _extract_function_signature(func_ast_node):
    """Extracts function signature from an AST node of a function"""
    func_signature = AstUtils.get_function_signature(func_ast_node)
    # Remove the leading space in the function signature
    if func_signature.startswith(' '):
        func_signature = func_signature[1:]
    return func_signature


def _extract_class_signature(class_ast_node):
    """Extracts class signature from an AST node of a class"""
    return class_ast_node.name
